prompt.alinti: Don't put your app on the internet until you have installed these three free security plugins that will make sure your website or app is safe.
The first is Cloudflare's security audit skill.
Past 12,000 stars, it turns your coding agent into a security auditor that hunts your codebase for vulnerabilities,
then has a fresh agent try to disprove every finding so you're never chasing false alarms.
The second is Alibaba's Open Code Review, which is at 36,000 stars.
It caught millions of defects inside Alibaba, and it reads every pull request you open for SQL injection and XSS,
so nothing exploitable ever hits production.
And finally, Coder, at 15,000 stars, it runs your AI agent in locked-down workspaces on your own servers
with zero API keys stored inside and every action tied to a real user so your secrets never leak through an agent.
Audit it, review it, lock it down, and it's all for free.
So if you guys want all three plugins, just comment 'security' down below and I'll send you the link.
